assumptions.benchmark: Buy at first open after lookback completed closes; hold to final close
assumptions.drawdown: Positive maximum close-equity drawdown from running peak including period opening equity
assumptions.execution: At next observed session open; signals at final close cannot execute
assumptions.fees: basis points of actual filled notional each side
assumptions.period_boundary: Continuous portfolio; holdout starts from previous close equity, including overnight P&L
assumptions.position_sizing: All available cash into fractional shares, including buy fee; no leverage or shorting
assumptions.rebalance: Daily target assessment; trade only when flat/long state changes
assumptions.return_units: fractions, not percent; no annualization or inferred sessions-per-year
assumptions.selected_parameters: Fixed before simulation; no parameter search
assumptions.signal_information: Current and previous completed closes only; equality means flat
assumptions.slippage: adverse basis points from quoted open each side
assumptions.source: Authored synthetic demonstration; scripts/generate_synthetic_data.py; Python random.Random seed 20261114; no market observations or exchange holiday calendar
assumptions.strategy: long when close > trailing simple mean; flat otherwise
assumptions.turnover_definition: Sum of absolute traded quantity times quoted open divided by pre-trade open equity

checks.details: Source, completeness, tradability, and corporate-action treatment are user declarations; no data vendor verification was performed.

warnings: Synthetic demonstration data: outcomes provide no empirical market evidence.
Historical or synthetic simulation does not establish predictive accuracy or trading profitability.
No dividends, interest on cash, taxes, market impact, liquidity constraints, or minimum lot sizes are modeled.
Open and close prices must use the same adjustment basis. Unadjusted splits invalidate economic interpretation.
Gross and net portfolios compound separately; their terminal equity difference includes compounding, not only summed costs.
Final positions are marked at the last close without forced liquidation or exit costs.
Changing parameters after viewing holdout results invalidates an out-of-sample claim. No optimization is performed.
